title: Underlying exact single-arrow transport before specializing categories
statement: Given an exact additive functor G from an abelian category C to an abelian category D, both with their derived categories, q : I → G(X), y : G(Y) → J and f : single(X) → single(Y)[2], underlyingSingleArrow G q y f is single(q) followed by mapSingleArrow G 2 f [def-sp-tower-class-reduction] and the shift by two of single(y).

source.place: clause (2), evaluation gives the finite Kummer first Chern class; expanded SmoothPurityTowerClasses proof, steps 5--8

proof.text: Compose the single functor applied to q, the exact functor single-arrow transport of f, and the shift by two of the single functor applied to y. The definition constructs the actual arrow. Both categories and all their witnesses remain parameters, so later specialization need not rebuild their concrete compositions.

proof_origin.place: clause (2), underlying integral arrow in the finite evaluation calculation

def underlyingSingleArrow
    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] [Abelian C]
    {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D] [Abelian D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} D]
    (G : C ⥤ D) [G.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    {X Y : C} {I J : D} (q : I ⟶ G.obj X) (y : G.obj Y ⟶ J)
    (f : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj X ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj Y)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) :
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor D 0).obj I ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor D 0).obj J)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
